title: Three-Way Open-Set Detection for Robust Autonomous Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2511.15343v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Autonomous navigation in complex scenes requires reliable perception across scenarios that the model did not encounter during its training. Along its route, an autonomous framework encounters objects it was trained to recognize, obstacles it has never seen, and background structures that resemble objects. Each of the three must be handled differently. To tackle this, existing open-set and out-of-distribution detectors discard low-confidence detections with an objectness threshold and only then test the rest for novelty. By forcing a single threshold like this they introduce a trade-off where a low threshold adds background clutter to the detected objects, while a high one may discard needed novel objects. We instead formulate open-set detection as a three-way classification of each detection into known object, unknown object, or background, computed post hoc from the outputs of a pretrained detector. translated_title: 面向鲁棒自主导航的三路开放集检测
translated_abstract: 摘要：复杂场景下的自主导航需要模型在训练中未遇到的情境下也能进行可靠感知。在行驶路线中，自主框架会遇到它被训练识别的物体、从未见过的障碍物，以及类似物体的背景结构。这三种情况必须分别处理。为了解决这一问题，现有的开放集和分布外检测器通过一个物体性阈值丢弃低置信度的检测结果，然后仅对剩余部分进行新颖性测试。通过强制使用单一阈值，它们引入了一种权衡：低阈值会将背景杂波混入检测到的物体中，而高阈值可能会丢弃所需的新颖物体。相反，我们将开放集检测表述为对每个检测结果的三路分类，即已知物体、未知物体或背景，这种分类是基于预训练检测器输出的后验计算。我们开发了用于领域适应的方法。
tldr: 本文提出将开放集检测重新定义为三路分类（已知物体、未知物体或背景），以替代传统单一阈值方法，从而消除自主导航中低置信度检测的权衡问题，并开发了相应的领域适应方法。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates open-set detection as three-way classification (known object, unknown object, or background) to replace traditional single-threshold methods, eliminating the trade-off in low-confidence detections for autonomous navigation, and develops domain adaptation methods.
